βάλλεν: βάλλω — throw, cast; impf. 3 sg., with movable ν
δαΐδων: δαΐς — pine-torch, brand; fem. gen. pl. (Attic δᾴς, gen. pl. δᾳδῶν)
δαιδάλλων: δαιδάλλω — work cunningly, adorn with art; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.
δυναίμην: δύναμαι — be able; pres. opt. 1 sg. mid., in a wish (αἲ γάρ … δυναίμην ’would that I could’)
εἴων: ἐάω — allow, let be; impf. 1 sg. (or 3 pl.), augmented: ’I allowed’; with οὐκ ’I would not let’
θαλάμων: θάλαμος — chamber, room; masc. gen. pl.
θαύμαζον: θαυμάζω — marvel at, wonder at; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented
κέλευσέ: κελεύω — bid, order; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= Attic ἐκέλευσε)
κύκλῳ: κύκλος — circle, ring; dat. sg. used adverbially: ’in a circle, all round’
λοετρῶν: λοετρόν — bath; neut. gen. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic λουτρῶν)
μελόντων: μέλω — be a care to, concern; pres. imper. 3 pl. (also μελέτωσαν) ’let them be a care’
ξεστοῖσι: ξεστός — polished, smoothed (verbal adj. of ξέω ’scrape smooth’); masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οῖς)
οἷά: οἷος — of what kind, such as; relative/exclamatory adj., neut. nom./acc. pl., with τε in a comparison: ’just as, like’ · also neut. acc. pl. relative, object of a verb: ’such things as’ (οἷά κ’ ἔχωμεν ’such as we may have’)
πέλωρ: πέλωρ — monster, portent, huge creature; neut. nom. sg., also said of a person in apposition: ’monster’
παντοίην: παντοῖος — of every kind, all sorts of; fem. acc. sg.
παρέμμεναι: πάρειμι — be near, be present; pres. inf., epic -μεναι (= Attic παρεῖναι)
ποίει: ποιέω — make; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= Attic ἐποίει)
ποίησε: ποιέω — make, create, fashion; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐποίησε)
πρόσωπα: πρόσωπον — face; neut. acc. pl. (plural for one face)
ἀλλάων: ἄλλος — other; fem. gen. pl., epic ἀλλάων (= Attic ἄλλων): ’of other (women)’ · also fem. gen. pl. of cities: ’of other (cities)’ (ἐξ ἀλλάων πολίων)
ἀμοιβηδὶς: ἀμοιβηδίς — in turn, by turns; adv.
ἀποκρύψαι: ἀποκρύπτω — hide away, conceal; aor. inf. act.: ’to hide’
ἀποφθιμένου: ἀποφθίνω — perish, die; aor. part. mid. masc. gen. sg.: ’dead’
ἀρημένος: ἀρημένος — worn down, distressed, oppressed; Homeric participle shaped like a perf. pass., masc. nom. sg.; verb and derivation uncertain (perh. tied to ἀρή ’harm’)
ἄμμορός: ἄμμορος (= ἄμορος) — without a share, having no part; fem. nom. sg., + gen.
ἐθέλοι: ἐθέλω — wish, be willing; pres. opt. 3 sg.
ἐξιέναι: ἔξειμι — go out, go forth; pres. inf.
ἐποίπνυον: ποιπνύω — bustle, be busy, hasten about; impf. 3 pl.: ’bustled about’
ἐργάζεσθαι: ἐργάζομαι — work, labour; pres. inf. mid., of purpose: ’to work (for)’
ἔπραθον: πέρθω — sack, destroy; aor. 1 sg. (ἔπραθον, the aor. 2 stem πραθ-): ’I sacked’
ἔτλην: τλάω — endure, bear, suffer; aor. 1 sg.: ’I endured’
ἥφαιστ: Ἥφαιστος — Hephaestus, god of the forge; masc. voc. sg., elided ἥφαιστ’ (= Ἥφαιστε)
ἱέσθην: ἵημι (mid.) — be eager, hasten, set oneself; impf. mid. 3 dual: ’were eager (to go)’
ἱκάνομαι: ἱκάνω — come to, reach, arrive at; pres. 1 sg. mid. (deponent form ἱκάνομαι): ’I come to (your knees)’
ὠρίωνα: Ὠρίων — Orion, the constellation; masc. acc. sg.
ῥέξαντα: ῥέζω — do, act, perform; aor. part. act. masc. acc. sg.: ’having done’
